13.2 For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">The licence provisions meet the preferred position in full. § 13.1 grants the access/subscription right directly to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf" (no written-notice condition, so better than fallback), and § 13.2 gives a "perpetual, irrevocable" fully paid licence to Customer and its Affiliates for paid-up software and Vendor Technology, expressly permitting contractors to support that material. § 13.3 confines Vendor's revocation/suspension rights to "a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure," so the subscription licence is not revocable at will. § 13.3 also permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by § 24, and § 24.1 allows assignment without Vendor consent to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets, with § 24.4 barring Vendor from terminating or repricing on Customer change of control. The § 13.4 restrictions are narrow and expressly do not limit authorized testing or use of Customer Data and output, so they do not undercut agreed use. No redline required.
